## Description

KPIs: visits, notes signed same day, documentation time per visit (estimate with method caveat), unreviewed results > 48 h, no-show rate, revenue, follow-up completion; charts (visits per day by doctor/location, open loops); drill-down only to authorised detail. Owner walkthrough session.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Documentation time is labelled as an estimate with the method stated; no clinical outcome claims.
- [ ] **AC2.** Drill-down respects role permissions (admins see counts; clinicians see their patients).
- [ ] **AC3.** Figures reconcile with source data for a sample month.
- [ ] **AC4.** Owner dashboard walkthrough delivered to each pilot owner (delivery package 2).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
